inj.note: Love is working his way back from an ankle injury that kept him out for Week 6 but is still not ready to ramp up to practice participation. He'll have a chance to get back in the mix Thursday or Friday, but if Love is unable to do so, it'll be a mix of Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight on Sunday against the Broncos.

news.h: Cardinals 'do what's right,' rule RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) out vs. Rams
news.d: The Cardinals say they're doing "what's right" for RB Jeremiyah Love by ruling the prized rookie out for Sunday's game against the Rams due to his injured left ankle.

news.h: Love (ankle) sits out Cardinals practice as LaFleur says rest 'vital'
news.d: Arizona Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love didn't practice Wednesday to rest his ailing left ankle. His status for Sunday's game against the Rams isn't clear.

news.h: Jeremiyah Love 'trending well' to play despite ankle reinjury
news.d: Cardinals rookie running back Jeremiyah Love aggravated his ankle injury last week against the Giants. He was limited in practice this week but is trending to play against the Lions.
